raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview vllm-project/vllm#51974 added `profiler_kwargs` to `POST /start_profile`: Python forwards it to the engine's `profile` utility, which merges it into the torch profiler kwargs. The Rust route had no such field, so serde ignored it and the engine profiled with its configured defaults. This PR forwards it. ## Claims - `POST /start_profile` on the Rust frontend accepts `profiler_kwargs` (a JSON object) and passes it unchanged as the fifth argument of the engine `profile` utility call, `nil` when absent, as Python sends `None`. - Like Python, the frontend does not interpret the keys. ## Validation Commands from `.buildkite/scripts/run-rust-frontend-cargo-ci.sh` (`style-clippy` and `test`), run from the repo root: ``` cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check # ok cargo sort --workspace --check rust # ok cargo deny --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --config rust/deny.toml check bans # ok cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings # ok cargo nextest run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-features --locked --no-fail-fast # 2310 tests run: 2310 passed, 13 skipped ``` - `start_profile_route_forwards_session_overrides` now sends `profiler_kwargs` and asserts that the msgpack `profile` call to the scripted mock engine carries it as the fifth argument; it fails when the route passes `None` instead. - The no-override tests assert the fifth argument is `nil` (shared `profile_start_without_overrides` helper). ## Details Python path: the route forwards `StartProfileRequest.model_dump(exclude_none=True)` to `AsyncLLM.start_profile`, which calls the `profile` utility as `(True, profile_prefix, delay_iterations, max_iterations, profiler_kwargs)` (`vllm/v1/engine/core_client.py`); `EngineCore.profile` hands it to the executor, and `vllm/profiler/wrapper.py` merges it. Rust: `StartProfileRequest` (`rust/src/server/src/routes/profile.rs`) gains the field, and `EngineCoreClient::start_profile` sends it as the fifth argument. The route DTO owns the field and `vllm-engine-core-client` owns the utility's wire arguments, so the value travels along the existing `start_profile` path with one added parameter and no new validation. Known difference, unchanged here: a wrongly typed override (`"profiler_kwargs": "invalid"`) gets Rust's JSON-body 400 where Python returns 422, as for the other three fields. `tests/entrypoints/serve/test_profile_api_router.py` is in-process and cannot run against the Rust frontend. Not a duplicate: no open PR touches the Rust `/start_profile` route. AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to prepare this change; the human submitter reviewed every changed line. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01K2SEJPm2Mawmm6pu8m9E1o ---

(Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
